problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 3 \\ -12 & -8 & -4 \\ 36 & -32 & 46\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & 1 & 0 \\ 9 & \boxed{} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & -8 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{32}$ in the matrix $L?$

examples.knowledge_point: Finding Missing Numbers in the Matrix L of an LU Factorization
examples.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14062864/assets/092a8a3d8ca1efa88189085838d4782072a254ac3790cf01f25ad9b5d0bca0ca.png)

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry $l_{31}$ in the matrix $L?$
examples.worked_solution:
We want to make $0$ at the position $a_{{\color{blue}3}{\color{red}1}}$ using Gaussian elimination. To do this, we take the ${\color{blue}3}$rd row of $A,$ and we add the ${\color{red}1}$st row of $A$ multiplied by ${\color{purple}-4}{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & -6 & 1 \\ 4 & 8 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & -6 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The entry $l_{{\color{blue}3}{\color{red}1}}$ of the matrix $L$ is the factor next to $R_1,$ taken with the opposite sign:

$$
l_{31}=-({\color{purple}-4})=4
$$

feedback.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & -1 \\ 7 & 3 & -5 \\ 63 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 9 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & -1 \\ \boxed{} & \boxed{} & \boxed{} \\ 0 & 0 & 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}.
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. From left to right, what are the missing elements from the second row of the matrix $U?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The matrix $U$ in the LU decomposition is obtained from the original matrix $A$ by row-reducing using Gaussian elementation. In particular, to make $0$ at the position ${a}_{21}$ of the matrix $A,$ we proceed as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & -1 \\ 7 & 3 & -5 \\ 63 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & -4 \\ 63 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, from left to right, the elements from the second row of $U$ are $0,3,$ and $-4.$
